svg.title: Parcel courier — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as parcel courier, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A sealed rectangular parcel with its centre tape sits beside a separate angled delivery scanner. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
